name: Being Stupid
overview: Scripture contrasts the folly of rejecting instruction with the wisdom of embracing God's truth, as seen in Proverbs where hatred of reproof is called brutish. Even those who acknowledge their own lack of understanding can find freedom by knowing the truth of Christ. Jesus calls His followers to be both wise and innocent, relying on God's power where human wisdom falls short. Submission to God-ordained authorities further reflects a wise acknowledgment of divine order in a fallen world.
